mapper.sql: ( SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id ORDER BY ur.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS role
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, username AS username, password AS password, real_name AS realName, phone AS phone, email AS email, avatar AS avatar, status AS status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, deleted AS deleted FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = 0

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.avatar AS avatar, u.status AS status,
, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(u.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM sys_user u
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = #{excludeRoleCode} )
ORDER BY u.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(u.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM sys_user u
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} )
ORDER BY u.id DESC

SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.avatar AS avatar, u.status AS status,
, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(u.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM sys_user u WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted = 0
SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone AS phone FROM sys_user u WHERE u.phone = #{phone} AND u.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password, real_name, phone, email, status, deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{deleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET real_name = #{realName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} ORDER BY u.id ASC
